# Brand identity · 品牌

Archives to see how a form has already been solved, publications that critique identity work, real guideline documents, studio case studies, and the tools for naming and trademark checks.

36 resources, plus 2 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `scripts/catalog.py find` searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Logo archives · logo 档案

Search the client's initial, shape family and industry before sketching. Similarity to an existing mark is a legal risk, not only a taste issue.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Logobook](https://www.logobook.com) | Archive of the world's classic logos, browsable by letter, shape, object and designer; images can be saved directly | Browse /letter/<a>/ for the client's initial, /shape/<circle\|arrows…>/ or /business/<industry>/ to see how a form has already been solved | S | archive | static | free |  |
| [Logosystem](https://logosystem.co) | Contemporary logos indexed by symbol, letter and designer | Filter by type (/logos/wordmark, /logos/symbol, /animated), colour, shape and industry; each /logo/<slug> page names the designer; /app-icons for app marks | A | archive | static | free |  |
| [Logo Design Love](https://www.logodesignlove.com) | David Airey's long-running blog on logo craft, process and case studies | Read the process posts before presenting logo options | A | article | static | free · slow |  |
| [Logo Archive](https://logo-archive.org) | 5,500+ historical, mostly modernist marks, each documented with designer and year | Reference for reductive, geometric construction | A | archive | js | free |  |
| [Logopedia](https://logos.fandom.com/wiki/Logopedia) | Logo evolution timelines for thousands of brands | Use for rebrand equity audits: what stayed constant across redesigns | A | archive | blocked | free |  |
| [Emblemetric](https://www.emblemetric.com) | Quantitative analysis of logo trends from trademark data | Evidence on how common a colour or form is in a category | B | article | static | free · slow |  |
| [LogoLounge](https://www.logolounge.com) | Large member-submitted logo database; the annual trend report is free | Read the trend report to know which cliches to avoid | B | archive | static | paid · login |  |

Learn the vocabulary of identity critique and how systems extend beyond the logo.

## Brand guideline collections · 品牌规范合集

Open three guidelines from a similar industry and compare their contents before writing one.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Brand Guidelines](https://brandguidelines.net) | Collection of official brand guideline documents (Twitch, Instacart, Asana and more) | Open three from a similar industry and compare their table of contents | A | archive | static | free |  |
| [Branding Style Guides](https://brandingstyleguides.com) | Large archive of brand manuals and style guides, many as PDFs | Browse /directory/<letter>/ or filter by /label/<industry>/, /publication-year/<year>/ and /publication-country/; many entries link the original PDF | A | archive | static | free |  |
| [Standards](https://standards.site) | Platform for web-native brand guidelines with public examples | Study /examples/ (Mailchimp, Cash App, McLaren) for how a living guideline site is structured | A | tool | static | freemium |  |
| [Standards Manual](https://standardsmanual.com) | Reissues of landmark graphics standards manuals (NASA, NYCTA, EPA) | Previews show how rigorous systems were specified | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Brandfetch](https://brandfetch.com) | Logos, colours and fonts of 50M+ companies by domain, via search, a free Logo API and an MCP server | Collect a competitor line-up by domain; agents use the MCP or Logo API instead of scraping logos | A | tool | static | freemium | [MCP server](https://brandfetch.com/developers/mcp); [Logo API](https://brandfetch.com/developers/logo-api) |
| [Deck Gallery (home: graphic)](https://deck.gallery) | Curated presentation decks: pitch decks, brand guidelines, reports, portfolios and talks, with per-slide pages | Use /category/pitch/, /category/guideline/ and /slides/ (slides by purpose) to compare title, statement, data and image slides; agents read the free JSON catalogue | A | gallery | static | free | [Pitch deck examples](https://www.deck.gallery/category/pitch/); [Public catalog API (OpenAPI)](https://www.deck.gallery/openapi.json); API `https://www.deck.gallery/api/catalog/decks.json` |

## Naming and trademark search · 命名与商标检索

An agent cannot clear a mark. These tools find obvious conflicts; a professional search is still required.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [中国商标网 (zh)](https://sbj.cnipa.gov.cn) | Official portal of China's trademark office; its online search (商标网上查询) is the authoritative check for mainland names and marks | Open 商标网上查询 from the portal and search the name, its pinyin and the figurative-element codes in the relevant Nice classes | A | tool | static | free · login | [商标网上查询 (search system)](https://wcjs.sbj.cnipa.gov.cn/) |
| [Onym](https://guide.onym.co) | Curated guide to naming: process, tools, references | Follow its process when the brief includes a name | A | guideline | static | free · slow |  |
| [WIPO Global Brand Database](https://branddb.wipo.int) | Worldwide trademark search including image similarity | Run an image search on a candidate mark; a lawyer's clearance is still required | A | tool | js | free | [Similar-name search](https://branddb.wipo.int/en/similarname); [Similar-logo (image) search](https://branddb.wipo.int/en/similarlogo) |
| [TMview](https://www.tmdn.org/tmview/) | Trademark search across many national and regional offices | Search a candidate name across EU and national offices, then filter by Nice class, office and status | A | tool | js | free |  |
| [USPTO Trademark Search](https://tmsearch.uspto.gov) | Official US trademark search (replaced TESS in 2023) | Run a knock-out search on names and marks for US filings, filtering by class and live status; not a legal clearance | A | tool | js | free |  |
| [Igor Naming Guide (PDF)](https://www.igorinternational.com/process/i/Igor%20Naming%20Guide%202022A.pdf) | Taxonomy of name types (functional, invented, experiential, evocative) with evaluation criteria | Classify candidate names before judging them | A | article | blocked | free · slow |  |
| [Tmkoo (标库网) (zh)](https://www.tmkoo.com) | Third-party Chinese trademark search mirroring CNIPA data, with free similar-name, status and gazette lookups | Use for a quick similar-name check before the official CNIPA search; ignore the filing-service upsell | B | tool | static | freemium |  |
| [Instant Domain Search](https://instantdomainsearch.com) | Checks domain availability across TLDs as you type, with generated alternatives | Run the name shortlist through it before presenting; an available domain changes which names survive | B | tool | static | free |  |
